caption:
You're so disappointed in who you've become. But what if your worth was never yours to decide? (Galatians 3:2 devotional)

You didn't receive the Spirit by works but by hearing with faith — which means your value was fixed by the Son's blood, not your performance. Like the merchant who sold everything for one pearl, Christ paid all He had to buy you. So even the self you resent is no longer yours to mark down.
